name: get_academic_overview
description: Combine cached Paideia and Campus Virtual schedule, deadlines, grades, materials, and status-only alerts. Includes live-clock academicContext from the curated KIT PUCP calendar registry. Use referenceWeek and explicit section labels before choosing current materials; use referenceDate for a future class. If calendarRegistration.required is true, refresh the registry with get_academic_calendar and report a missing term honestly; use set_academic_calendar only as a temporary local fallback.

referenceDate.description: Optional target class date for material matching; does not replace the current server date.
